headline: Clearer assignment warnings, availability, and event notifications.
highlights: Save ministry status reliably and spot inactive members whose event assignments need a replacement.
Replace inactive assignments from the member's row; inactive members are no longer prompted to confirm or decline.
See declined assignments and approved leave in one Availability badge, with readable reasons in light and dark mode.
Open assignment notifications directly to Team; desktop opens an event modal over the current screen.
Mobile inactive rows match the event list, and desktop event dialogs keep a steady size across tabs.
